name: DICEUS
country: TBC — DICEUS is founded in Ukraine (associated country, fully eligible for Horizon Europe) and operates offices in Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. Confirm the exact LEGAL ENTITY and its country of registration before any application — eligibility and funding rate depend on it.
description: DICEUS is a European product-led InsurTech company (founded 2011) developing and commercialising configurable, ready-made insurance software products. It has evolved from a custom software engineering provider into a product-focused technology company with 250+ professionals and 150+ delivered projects across insurance, banking, healthcare, logistics, and financial services. Its portfolio is built on a shared cloud-native, API-first, modular technology foundation with embedded, reusable AI services. As an SME it seeks funding for its own product-led R&D, primarily DIRECT single-company instruments, but is open to indirect (consortium / cascade) routes.
researchAreas: Trustworthy & Explainable AI (XAI) for regulated industries (human-in-the-loop decision support, audit trails, governance)
AI-assisted underwriting and intelligent document processing (extraction from unstructured insurance documents)
Predictive analytics, forecasting and anomaly detection for insurance/financial operations
Configurable low-code insurance core platforms (Policy Administration Systems)
Cloud-native, API-first, microservices software architecture and interoperability
Enterprise cybersecurity & operational resilience (DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, SWIFT CSP)
Standardised cross-organisational data exchange (reinsurance/insurance data spaces, interoperability)
InsurTech / FinTech digital transformation and intelligent process automation

expertise: Explainable AI: recommendations with supporting evidence, confidence indicators, business-rule traceability, full audit trails

Decision intelligence: preliminary risk scoring, pricing/quotation support, referral management, straight-through processing

Software engineering: cloud-native architecture, microservices, DevSecOps, CI/CD, Secure SDLC
Regulatory/compliance engineering: GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, DORA, SWIFT CSP, IFRS 17
Enterprise integration: API-first services interoperating with PAS, Claims, CRM, EHR, actuarial, fraud-detection and external data providers

strategicDirection.inScope: DEVELOPMENT OF INSURANCE-SECTOR PRODUCTS enhanced with AI: risk detection/assessment, minimisation of errors, and automation of insurance operations (underwriting, claims, policy admin, reinsurance, reporting). AI is applied to make DICEUS's own commercial insurance products better.
strategicDirection.outOfScope: NOT DICEUS's path: security / cybersecurity / civil-security domains (SecureAI, SSRI-01) and clinical / medical / healthcare-diagnostic AI. These were rejected as off-strategy. AI-security or DORA topics only count if framed around DICEUS's own insurance product, not as a security-research contribution.
strategicDirection.note: Feedback from DICEUS 2026-07-26: picked directions (security, medicine) are not their way; their development path is insurance-sector products with AI for risk detection, error minimisation, automation.

fundingInterests.preference: DIRECT single-company / bottom-up funding STRONGLY preferred — where DICEUS pitches its OWN insurance-AI product and defines the innovation itself (no imposed vertical). Indirect (consortium partner / cascade FSTP) only when the topic centres on insurance/finance operations.
priorityTracks: DIRECT single-SME, bottom-up (BEST FIT for the confirmed direction): EIC Accelerator — grant up to ~EUR 2.5M + optional equity, deep-tech, TRL 5-8, applicant defines the product. Ideal for AI Underwriting Workbench / risk & automation products, with NO sector gatekeeping.
SEMI-DIRECT, bottom-up: Eurostars / Eureka (SME-led collaborative R&D, open topic; needs >=1 foreign partner). Also lets DICEUS pitch its own insurance-AI product.
DIRECT-ish, lightweight: cascade / FSTP open calls ONLY where scope covers finance/insurance/RegTech or horizontal AI adoption (single applicant, EUR 50k-200k).

INDIRECT (narrow): Horizon/DIGITAL RIA/IA consortia ONLY where the topic centres on insurance/financial operations, regulatory reporting automation, or trustworthy AI FOR the insurance value chain — NOT generic security or health verticals.
